prompt:
You are scouting a single volleyball match from a fixed camera.

CRITICAL: This is a convention hall with several courts running at once. Analyse ONLY the main court in the foreground -- the one with the referee standing on the elevated stand at the centre of the frame. Other matches are visible in the background; ignore them completely.

The net runs up the middle of the frame, so each team occupies one half of the image. Identify a team ONLY by which half of the frame they are standing in -- "left" or "right" as you see it on screen. Do not use jersey colour.

This clip begins at {start:.2f} seconds into the match and runs for 6 seconds.

MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE EVENTS (ONE PER CONTACT):
Output EXACTLY ONE event type per physical ball contact. Never output multiple events for the exact same contact. Choose the single best fit:
- If an attack wins the rally, label it ONLY as `kill` (do not also output `attack`).
- If a block wins the point, label it ONLY as `block`.
- Never output both a `dig` and a `receive` for the same pass.

ACTION DEFINITIONS:
DO NOT REPORT EVERY CONTACT. You MUST skip regular sets, non-scoring blocks, and dead-time passing.
  serve   - starts a rally. Hit from behind the back line OVER the net from a stationary toss. If a player hits a ball that is already moving, or jumps to hit a pass, it is NEVER a serve. Do not guess "serve" just because it is the first action in a clip.
  receive - a defensive pass handling the opponent's serve, directed to a teammate.
  dig     - a defensive pass handling the opponent's attack, directed to a teammate.
  set     - a pass placing the ball for an attacker. ONLY report if it directly leads to a kill (an assist). SKIP ALL OTHER SETS. Do not mislabel skipped sets as digs or receives.
  attack  - an offensive hit aimed to score by sending the ball OVER the net. Includes freeballs. If a pass goes intentionally over the net, it is an attack, not a dig or receive.
  kill    - an offensive hit that immediately wins the rally.
  block   - a block AT THE NET. ONLY report if it immediately wins the point (a stuff block). Skip all other block touches!

DEAD TIME VETO: Between rallies, players casually pass the ball under the net, practice, or bounce it. IGNORE ALL DEAD TIME CONTACTS. If players are standing casually or walking around, it is dead time. Only report competitive live rally play.

For each contact give:
  t       - the time of contact in ABSOLUTE MATCH SECONDS. Add the offset within this clip to the clip start of {start:.2f}. Be precise to a fraction of a second.
  type    - one of the seven above
  side    - "left" or "right": which half of the frame the contacting player is standing in
  number  - the contacting player's jersey number as a string, or null if you cannot read it. Do not guess.
  error   - true if this contact was an error (into the net, out of bounds, mishandled)
  point   - true ONLY for the final contact of a rally if it directly WON the point (like a kill, stuff block, or unreturnable serve). NEVER set true for regular digs, receives, or errors!

Report only contacts you actually observe. Do not invent a full rally structure based on assumptions. If no play happens in this clip, return an empty list.
